P.flaw: The belly plate and hatch are small and partly crowded by the leg ends, and the brass hatch blends with the pole disc when seen from below.

Q.flaw: The pole sticks a long way out below the belly with a finial, which pulls attention from the hatch when seen from below.

model-1.why_top: Q has a clearer saddle with pommel, a charcoal mane and bridle that make the forward-facing head read better, and a crisp hatch rectangle on a well-framed black belly plate.

P.flaw: The amber lamp is a lumpy, spiky blob hidden behind the arm, so it does not read as a round housing from the cab.

Q.flaw: The large lamp cylinder sits in front of the pivot and covers the iron boss in the front view.

model-2.why_top: Q's clean round amber lamp, clearly raised striped arm and solid tapered footing read at a distance, while P's lamp is a messy, hidden shape.
